Voice brief — NARRATOR: warm, punchy 1940s radio-serial announcer; mid-Atlantic; relishes cliffhangers.
Voice brief — CAPTAIN MARVEL: adult man, 30s, deep and booming but good-natured; big-brother confidence, jaunty wisecracks.
Voice brief — BILLY BATSON: boy, about 12-14; bright, quick, earnest American kid reporter.
Voice brief — AMES: elderly professor, 70s; bookish, absent-minded, slightly creaky, easily startled but stubborn.
Voice brief — WILSON: middle-aged, 50s; smooth, oily, faintly nasal; fake politeness hiding contempt. Should be recognisably related to MUMMY but not obviously the same.
Voice brief — MUMMY: Wilson in disguise; low, rasping, theatrical villain; booming curses and cackles. Could share Wilson's voice pitched/processed lower.
Voice brief — DOTTIE: young woman, late teens/20; spunky, fast-talking, wisecracking 1940s girl reporter.
Voice brief — MISS DALSHAW: middle-aged secretary; one startled gasp.
Voice brief — BOARD MEMBER 1: older man, nervous, fussy.
Voice brief — GUIDE: middle-aged Egyptian man; grave, fearful warning.
Voice brief — NAZI 1: gruff German-accented man, putting on a spooky voice.
Voice brief — NAZI 2: gruff German-accented man; one word.
